info.title: DurianOS API
info.description:
Offline-first household data sync.

**Dev sign-in (APP_ENV=dev):** call `POST /v1/auth/session` with provider `google` and id_token `dev:demo` (the seeded household), copy the `token`, click *Authorize* and paste it. `dev:<anything>` creates a fresh empty household.

post.description:
Swap a Google / Apple `id_token` for a session token.

Dev only (`APP_ENV=dev`): `dev:<subject>[:<name>]` is accepted as the token; the seeded
demo household is `dev:demo`.
Revoke the calling session (addition to the contract).

Username + password sign-in for admin accounts (addition to the contract).

Returns the same `{token, user}` as `/v1/auth/session`; admin routes still require an
`admin_members` row.

delete.description:
Revoke every session and erase the user's rows in one transaction. Photo bytes are
removed afterwards from a `deletion_jobs` entry; `media_pending` counts them.

put.description: Where to tell this phone that a new scan model is out. One phone token, one owner.

post.description: Rebuild the release when the latest one failed; otherwise report the current one.
Registers a version as a draft and returns where to PUT the file.

patch.description:
Change the notes, the beta flag, the limits or the minimum app version of any version.
A phone that already has the file just refreshes these; it downloads nothing.

delete.description: Only a version that was never published; one a phone may hold stays for its history.

get.description: The exact text of a version a citation points at (it may have been unpublished since).
The published model of every body part. An empty `entries` is the honest "none yet".
A short-lived link to the file of a published version. The phone checks `sha256`.

create_plot.summary: Create a plot under the farm above

update_farm.summary: Update farm (send the revision you last saw; wrong rev => conflict)

get.description: Everything the caller has had acknowledged, tombstones included.
